enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Intelligence +4: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +4 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Charisma +4: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +4 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Evocation Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Insightful Wizardry +97: +97 Insight bonus to spell points.
Improved Demonic Shield: Each time you are hit in melee combat there is a chance that a shield of demonic energy will grant you a +120 Profane bonus to temporary hit points.
Epic Deadly Diabolist: 2 Pieces Equipped: Your Summons, Charmed Monsters, and Hirelings gain +8 to all Ability Scores.
